answer: Sybil resistance works best when identity is examined like light through a prism: one account may look plausible alone, but its history splits into distinct signals — past work, stake at risk, and independent attestors. A velvet-smooth signup flow should not hide that check. Require newcomers to forge reputation gradually, earning the right to vouch for others only after sustained, verifiable contributions, so cheap copies stay powerless while real agents accumulate trust.
